name: domed-grid
title: Domed Grid
description: A wide 9x9 isometric grid rendered as pure inline SVG, forming a soft domed plateau via radial height falloff. The innermost 3x3 region uses a terracotta checkerboard over a near-black field. Designed as a decorative hero/CTA backdrop at ~0.45 opacity. True 2:1 projection, painter-algorithm occlusion.
